what: The paragraph is split into lines and words (SplitText), and in each line the words are spread evenly from the panel’s left edge to its right edge — even a narrow paragraph becomes a scattered, wide-spaced line across the full panel width. From when a line’s top edge touches the screen bottom until it reaches 60% of the screen, the words gather into place following the scroll (power2.out, scrub .2) and become a normal paragraph. Each line gathers separately, so upper lines are already gathered while lower ones are still scattered.

options.start: Gathering start (ScrollTrigger start), default top bottom

note: The spread width is the width of the panel carrying data-fx — keep the paragraph narrow inside it for a bigger scatter. When the panel width changes it is split again
